deploy.startCommand: /bin/sh -c "scripts/replace-placeholder.sh $BUILT_NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBAPP_URL $NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBAPP_URL && scripts/wait-for-it.sh $DATABASE_HOST -t 120 -- true && npx prisma migrate deploy --schema packages/prisma/schema.prisma && npx ts-node --transpile-only scripts/seed-app-store.ts && cd apps/web && exec /calcom/node_modules/.bin/next start"

PORT.description: Port Cal.com listens on - leave as is

HOSTNAME.description: Listen on IPv6 and IPv4 so Railway's private network can reach it

NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBAPP_URL.description: Public URL of Cal.com (booking links, emails, OAuth callbacks). Rewritten into the built app on every boot - set it to your custom domain after adding one

NEXTAUTH_URL.description: Sign-in base URL - keep it equal to NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBAPP_URL

NEXTAUTH_SECRET.description: Signs login sessions - changing it logs everyone out

CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts stored calendar and app credentials (exactly 32 characters). BACK IT UP - changing it breaks every connected calendar

DATABASE_HOST.description: host:port the start command waits for before migrating

CALCOM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED.description: Turn off Cal.com's anonymous usage telemetry

RAILWAY_HEALTHCHECK_TIMEOUT_SEC.description: First boot applies ~590 database migrations and seeds the app store before the health check can pass

EMAIL_FROM.description: Optional sender address for booking confirmations and reminders, e.g. cal@example.com (Railway allows outbound SMTP on Pro only)

GOOGLE_API_CREDENTIALS.description: Optional Google OAuth client JSON for Google Calendar and Meet, e.g. {"web":{"client_id":"...","client_secret":"...","redirect_uris":["https://YOUR-DOMAIN/api/integrations/googlecalendar/callback","https://YOUR-DOMAIN/api/auth/callback/google"]}}

GOOGLE_LOGIN_ENABLED.description: Set to true to show Sign in with Google (needs GOOGLE_API_CREDENTIALS)

CALCOM_LICENSE_KEY.description: Optional Cal.com commercial license key for enterprise features (teams, workflows, insights). Leave empty for the AGPL edition

PGDATA.description: Data subdirectory - keeps Postgres happy on Railway volumes

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time for Postgres to shut down cleanly on redeploy
